rationale: AMLAS Version 1.1 explicitly lists six lifecycle stages from ML safety-assurance scoping through deployment, links system hazard/risk analysis to ML requirements, limits its scope to the ML component, says it should not be used in isolation, and states a primary focus on offline supervised learning. The challenge found no wording that turns this research guidance into regulator acceptance or a complete vehicle/aircraft approval method; the claim does not make either leap.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-004-R1 through S-CHAL-004-R3, AMLAS Version 1.1, PDF pp. 2-3
AMLAS Version 1.1, 'Overview of AMLAS' and 'Using this Document', https://www.york.ac.uk/media/assuring-autonomy/documents/AMLASv1.1.pdf
limitations: AMLAS is 2021 University of York guidance; no independent regulator acceptance or completed high-criticality application was established here.
Its stated component scope leaves system authority, operational permission, and integrated recovery evidence open.
